description: Phase 3.2 gate. For each question the graph retriever must return every gold node (recall 1.0). 'exact' means the result must equal the gold set. 'extra_ok' lists nodes the built corpus legitimately adds beyond the benchmark's hand-written gold (e.g. the API Gateway genuinely consumes the Ledger API per services/api-gateway.md). Gate questions are B09/B14/B16/B17/B24 from data/benchmark/questions.md.
